# Socialeum

> Socialeum is a Facebook Ads resource platform offering budget calculators, campaign planning tools, and localized guides for small businesses and digital marketers across multiple countries.

Socialeum specializes in helping entrepreneurs and SMEs optimize their Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns through practical tools and region-specific educational content. The platform serves markets including Bangladesh, Philippines, and English-speaking countries with tailored strategies for low-budget and high-growth campaigns.

## Key Topics

- Facebook Ads
- Budget Calculator
- Campaign Planning
- CPM Pricing
- Cost Estimation
- Ad Formats
- Targeting Options
- Business Growth
- Instagram Ads
- Reels Advertising
- Campaign Objectives
- Facebook Optimization
- Social Media Marketing
- PPC Advertising
- Content Strategy

## Core Tools

- [Facebook Ad Calculator](https://socialeum.com): Main Facebook Ad Calculator tool for budget planning across Meta platforms

## Regional Guides

- [Learn Facebook Ads for Bangladesh: From Beginner to Pro](https://socialeum.com/bangladesh): Comprehensive Facebook Ads guide for Bangladesh SMEs and low-budget campaigns
- [Socialeum (Bengali)](https://socialeum.com/bn): Facebook Ads guide for Bangladesh with Bengali content and digital marketing tips
- [Learn To Grow Your Business in Philippines with Facebook Ads](https://socialeum.com/philippines): Facebook Ads guide for Philippine small businesses covering PPC and Reels advertising

## About

- [About Us](https://socialeum.com/about-us): About Socialeum: Facebook resource for social media enthusiasts and optimization
